title: a newcomer filters Explore with a filter icon, kind pills and a bottom sheet

criteria.text: Kind pills (All, Events, ... Asks) fixed above the bottom nav, All default
criteria.note: Retired: 2026-09-12 'Zero filter pills outside the filter view' (F092 Rulings, design-language principle 10), 2026-09-17 'the shipped kind pill row does not survive' (F059 Rulings) and Don's 2026-10-18 [always] no chip or pill UI anywhere (#951). Built in T114, deleted in #174; `tests/no-chips.test.ts` (#956) fails CI on any `*Pill` component [V].

criteria.text: No separate market/category/day buttons; filter icon at the right of the sticky search bar
criteria.note: `ExploreSearchBar.tsx` is one `sticky top-0` row: the place (plain text with a pin since #956), search, and a sliders button labelled 'Open filters'; under 1024px the same four actions sit in `ExploreDock` [V]. Checked: unmarked: `ExploreSearchBar.test.tsx` ('shows no separate market, category or day buttons', 'sticks to the top of the viewport', 'offers the area, then search, then filters, in that order'); the invariant half is guard #624 (F092.1a) [V]. #652 asks for `[guards F045.N]` markers, which the plan lint rejects since #1069; a named test seen failing is what remains. Reviewed: T115 was a direct commit; #174 and #479 carry no `Reviewed by:` or are review-skipped; #881, #932, #911 and #956 carry `Reviewed by: Claude`; #1060 and #1069 are tests only, review-skipped [V]. Shipped: T115 had no deploy run (unknown); #174 9dde664f, #479 3c490272, #881 3da54545, #932 f8578fbb, #911 afcb9111, #956 546f0862, #1060 751f5ae5, #1069 c16d4f0b green [V]. Smoked: smoke-live scheduled run 41093000135 on main 09ffba30 (2026-10-30) was green and opened explore at 390 and 1280 for signed-out, stranger, member, owner and operator personas, after every merge here (runs 10-24 to 10-29 green too); it loads the route, it does not tap [V]. Open #624, #652.

criteria.text: The filter icon opens a sheet: schedule (any / this week / this weekend), category multi-select, Show results, Clear all when any filter is set
criteria.note: `ExploreFilterSheet.tsx` on the shared `Sheet`: since #881 (Don, 2026-10-16) the groups are Type (Everything / Pages / Posts, the post kinds, Following only), Category (the 12 interest tags, multi-select, plus My interests #911) and Date (Any time / Today / This weekend / This week / a picked day), with How far (#932) between; 'Show results' commits, 'Clear all' shows only when something is set, the draft is discarded on dismiss, modal with focus trap [V]. The scenario's 'schedule' is the Date group. Checked: #1060 (2026-10-26, closed #825) added one test claiming the criterion whole in `ExploreFilterSheet.test.tsx` ('opens with a Date choice (any, this week, this weekend) and a multi-select Category, Show results last at the bottom, Clear all only once something is set'), seen failing with Clear all shown always; #1069 made its marker a plain comment (the plan lint rejects markers for a deleted scenario); read as checked [V]. Reviewed: T115 was a direct commit; #174 and #479 carry no `Reviewed by:` or are review-skipped; #881, #932, #911 and #956 carry `Reviewed by: Claude`; #1060 and #1069 are tests only, review-skipped [V]. Shipped: T115 had no deploy run (unknown); #174 9dde664f, #479 3c490272, #881 3da54545, #932 f8578fbb, #911 afcb9111, #956 546f0862, #1060 751f5ae5, #1069 c16d4f0b green [V]. Smoked: smoke-live scheduled run 41093000135 on main 09ffba30 (2026-10-30) was green and opened explore at 390 and 1280 for signed-out, stranger, member, owner and operator personas, after every merge here (runs 10-24 to 10-29 green too); it loads the route, it does not tap [V].

criteria.text: The sheet offers a distance choice (1 / 5 / 10 / 25 mi)
criteria.note: Retired: 2026-09-03 'Distance is out' (`product/ui/surfaces.md`): no radius filter, no mile count, no distance sort; #174 deleted it [V]. Don's 2026-10-18 ruling on #796 (built in #932) adds a 'How far' group in minutes of drive (15 / 30 / 45 / 60 / Whole area), a reach ring, not a mile radius; `ExploreFilterSheet.test.tsx` still asserts 'offers no distance control' [V].

criteria.text: The sheet offers a sort order
criteria.note: Not built: #174 removed Sort ('ordering is the server's', `lib/browse/filters.ts` header); `ExploreFilterSheet.test.tsx` asserts 'offers no sort control' [V]. No ruling retires a member-chosen sort outright: 2026-09-03 rules out distance sort only, and F059 criterion 3 fixes the order (locality and recency, never payment or scrolling) without saying whether a member may re-sort. Routed to scope-scenario: ruling needed.

Not built: dropped in #174 (deviation 4) because nothing carried a recurrence rule; `DATE_OPTIONS` (`lib/browse/filters.ts`) is any / today / weekend / week plus a picked day (#881); `ExploreFilterSheet.test.tsx` asserts 'offers no Recurring schedule' [V]. Series and occurrence rows are ruled in `model.md` § Recurring events and tracked by F074 (#600); no filter reads a series [A]. Needs the PM: build, drop or wait, and the word. Open #827 (needs-pm).

criteria.text: Tapping the Events pill filters instantly to gatherings; pill selected state
criteria.note: Retired: 2026-09-12 'Zero filter pills', 2026-09-17 (F059) 'the shipped pill row does not survive', 2026-10-18 no chips anywhere; F092 criterion 1. Events is now a post kind inside the sheet's Type group (#881), committed by Show results [V].

criteria.text: Active secondary filters show as removable chips below the search bar; no chip for kind
criteria.note: Retired: 2026-09-12 'no pill row, chip row or control strip alongside results' (F092 Rulings, principle 10); 2026-09-19 narrowing happens in a modal that writes into the search box; 2026-10-18 no chip UI anywhere. `ActiveFilterChips` was deleted in #174 and `tests/no-chips.test.ts` keeps chips out [V].

criteria.text: Chip row disappears when no chips remain
criteria.note: Retired with criterion 5: there is no chip row (2026-09-12, 2026-09-19 and 2026-10-18 rulings, F092 criterion 1).

criteria.text: The URL carries kind, distance and sort filters
criteria.note: Retired: kind pills (2026-09-12, 2026-09-17) and distance and distance sort (2026-09-03) no longer exist, so nothing remains to put in the URL; `?sort=` and `?distance=` degrade to defaults on purpose (`parseBrowseFilters`) [V]. The Type group's words travel in `?q=` under 7b.

criteria.text: The URL carries the active schedule and tag filters; opening it restores them
criteria.note: The box text is the state: `browseQueryString` writes `q` (the Type, Category and Date words, the free search), `metro`, `area` and, since #932, `reach`; `BrowseSurface` seeds the box from `?q=`, writes old `?view=updates` and `?schedule=` links into it as words, and since #942 writes the URL with `history.replaceState` [V]. Checked: unmarked: `query.test.ts` ('round-trips through parseBrowseFilters'), `BrowseSurface.test.tsx` ('the URL carries the words, not separate filter parameters', 'typing writes the words into the URL in place'); nothing asserts a cold `?q=` load lands on the same results [V]. Reviewed: #174 has no `Reviewed by:`, #750 is review-skipped; #881 and #942 carry `Reviewed by: Claude` [V]. Shipped: #174 9dde664f, #750 c16c86a7, #881 3da54545, #942 a6d4682e deploy-health green [V]. Smoked: smoke-live scheduled run 41093000135 on main 09ffba30 (2026-10-30) was green and opened explore at 390 and 1280 for signed-out, stranger, member, owner and operator personas, after every merge here (runs 10-24 to 10-29 green too); it loads the route, it does not tap [V]. Open #652 (its text names the old `?category=`, `?schedule=` params).

criteria.text: Back from a detail page restores filters and scroll position
criteria.note: Retired: F059 criterion 10 (a shared link reopens the same metro and search; back-navigation restores scroll) is the newer, wider statement; the filters now live in `?q=`. Built in part (`useScrollRestoration('explore', ...)`; #885 keeps how deep the visitor scrolled); the remaining defects (one literal key, restores once per mount) are open #54 under F059 [V].

criteria.text: A dot on the filter icon when secondary filters are active
criteria.note: `filter-active-dot` and an 'Open filters — filters applied' label driven by `filtersActive` in `ExploreSearchBar.tsx`; the dock's filter button carries the same dot and label [V]. Checked: unmarked: `ExploreSearchBar.test.tsx` ('carries a dot when secondary filters are active', 'carries no dot when no secondary filter is set'), `ExploreDock.test.tsx` ('marks active filters') [V]. Reviewed, Shipped: as criterion 2. Smoked: smoke-live scheduled run 41093000135 on main 09ffba30 (2026-10-30) was green and opened explore at 390 and 1280 for signed-out, stranger, member, owner and operator personas, after every merge here (runs 10-24 to 10-29 green too); it loads the route, it does not tap [V]. Open #652.
